memory.intro: The helpers sent from this agent share one memory. At the start of each round, the few notes that bear on it go before what it hears; at the end, the "Remember:" lines in its report, and how far the ticket got, are kept.
memory.noIssues: Its helpers have not finished a round yet.
memory.nothing: Nothing remembered yet. A helper writes "Remember:" in its report, or you write one for it above.
memory.fading: Fading: the first to go when {keep} are kept
memory.listed: what it keeps is listed below
memory.sourcesNote: Connect, turn off, or change reading and writing under Settings.
memory.blank: Starting in this repo, nothing comes to mind.
memory.orchestratorIntro: The assistant reads its memory when it starts and after each compaction; what is remembered or forgotten in between, it knows by its next line.
memory.orchestratorNothing: Nothing remembered yet. Tell the assistant "Remember…", or write one for it above.
memory.noteRepo: Such as: clock-in's tests run with pnpm test, not npm
memory.noteOrchestrator: Such as: write commit messages in English; no night shifts on weekends
memory.noteHint: A sentence that is clear at a glance next time.
memory.noteHintRepo: A sentence that is clear at a glance next time. With no repo it holds for every repo.
